8 احتبس quasi-pass. of حَبَسَهُ; He, or it, was or became, confined, restricted, limited, &c.; and he confined, restricted, limited, &c., himself; (S, A, K;) [as also ↓ انحبس ; but this latter is probably post-classical.] ―
-b2- Said of urine [as meaning It became suppressed]. (S and Msb in art. حقب; &c.) ＝
-A2- احتبسهُ syn. with حَبسَهُ, which see, in two places. (S, K.) ―
-b2- Also He appropriated it to himself; restricted it to his own special possession: (A, TA:) or he made, or constituted, it (اِتَّخَذَهُ) what is termed حَبِيس. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
